body:

Runs after child 1 merges, since it needs the core feature list.

- Map every core feature in the north-star tables to its item or items in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`.
- Author the missing items through the `checklist-author` skill.
- Done when every core feature names at least one checklist item, or a filed card for the gap.
